Subject: GCP Marketplace listing: onboarding & procurement workflow

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Acme is keen to move forward with a public listing and co-sell motion on GCP. Procurement will need a clear procurement path (PO vs. Marketplace SKU purchase), expected billing cadence, and any DocuSign links for the Master Services Agreement.

Attached is a short kickoff slide with the target timeline and the initial list of required artifacts from our side. Can Redwood confirm the typical procurement flow you want buyers to follow (Marketplace purchase vs direct PO + invoice)? Also please list the minimum legal deliverables for moving the listing to public.

High level timeline proposed by Acme: internal approvals by Oct 20, procurement sign-off by Nov 3, listing live targeted Nov 15.

Thanks,
Santiago Morales
Strategic Partnerships — GCP Channel
GCP Partners

Date: 2026-10-12 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: onboarding & procurement workflow

Grace / Santiago —

Uploading the baseline checklist as discussed. Key highlights:
- Two supported procurement flows: 1) Marketplace public SKU purchase (recommended for self-serve customers) 2) Direct PO -> Invoice (for enterprise customers requiring contract/PO).
- Required artifacts from partner: technical listing manifest, support contact, billing contact, logo, and a signed MSA (we can accept redline).
- Billing note: Marketplace purchases are billed via GCP billing account and follow Google billing cadence; direct PO route results in Redwood invoicing Acme and offering net terms where agreed.
- Typical lead time for SKU setup in GCP Console: 5 business days once all artifacts received.

I've attached the checklist spreadsheet and a sample SKU mapping template.

-Karthik
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments: gcp-marketplace-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Quick notes from the billing/SKU side:

- For Acme's deployment size we recommend offering both a Marketplace SKU (metered by token/GB) and a direct contract SKU for enterprise accounts who want consolidated invoices.
- Action for Acme: confirm the preferred default route for customer-facing purchase flow. If default is Marketplace, we'll need to map product SKUs and supply a sample billing matrix (attached).
- Link to our internal billing playbook for mapping: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbooks/gcp-sku-mapping (Acme can ignore internal notes, we will extract the relevant table and share).

Ben
Billing & Partnerships Operations — Redwood Inference

Hi Grace / team,

Thanks — the timeline and checklist are clear. A few procurement-specific asks from our side:

1) Please provide the redlined MSA or a DocuSign-ready copy for Acme to review. We have standard security and data processing addenda that may need to be appended.
2) Confirm whether Redwood accepts PO + invoice for purchases originating from Marketplace SKUs (we sometimes prefer direct invoicing for certain enterprise pilots).
3) Can you share the expected invoice cadence if we take direct PO (monthly vs net-30)?

We can confirm internal approvals by Nov 3 if we have the redline by Oct 20. Also, please send a DocuSign link if you have a pre-populated MSA.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Acme Cloud

Thanks — moving this to action. Summary of commitments and next steps:

- Redwood will provide a redlined MSA and DocuSign link by Oct 20. (Attachment: redlined-MSA.docx)
- For buyers: we support Marketplace SKU purchases and a direct PO + invoice flow. If Acme wants Redwood to invoice Acme customers directly, we can enable that for enterprise pilots (net-30 by default — exceptions negotiable).
- Karthik will begin SKU provisioning once Acme uploads the technical manifest and logo (target: Oct 21).
- Ben to prepare the billing matrix and recommended default purchase route for Acme’s customer base (delivery: Oct 18).

I'll open a HubSpot deal and tag the procurement deliverables; HubSpot link below. Please flag anything missing and confirm acceptance of the plan.

Agenda for internal kick: Wed Oct 13, 10am PT (we moved some items into deliverables above) — if anyone needs to reschedule, ping me.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting the listing live.

Best,
